SRE Bot: Incident created: svc-inference-high-latency · severity=sev2 · region=us-west-2 · triggered by alert: p95 token latency > 1.5s for >5m · incident link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-1765432123
Jordan (oncall): acked and paging. I'm jumping in now.
Jordan (oncall): quick recap — spike correlates with a batch of long-context requests hitting hosted pools, KC cache size spiked, memory pressure + eviction visible in metrics.
Kyung (Runtime): confirming, seeing KV cache churn and repeated KV fetches from tensor-quantized models. evict rate up x6.
Matt (ENG): I'm on the worker group. Running a rolling restart on pool-usw2-gen1 to flush KV dirs, will monitor for drop in eviction.
Matt (ENG): command: `for id in $(get-workers pool-usw2-gen1); do restart-worker $id & done`
Deployment Bot: Rolling restart initiated for pool-usw2-gen1 by matt. 12/12 workers scheduled, concurrency=3.
Jordan (oncall): good. starting mitigation: reduce batching window on affected route + enable temporary routing to fallback model-variant (vqf-1 -> vqf-1-small).
Lena (SRE): notes for handoff — mitigation steps applied, latency trending down from p95=1.8s -> 0.9s after first wave. No error rate increase.
Lena (SRE): I'll prepare a short status-page update + a customer-facing note for impacted orgs. Drafts below.
Lena (SRE): STATUS PAGE DRAFT (short):
```
Status: Degraded performance (mitigated)
Start: 2024-10-03T08:02:03Z
Impact: Some hosted API requests in us-west-2 experienced elevated latency (p95 up to ~1.8s).
Current status: Mitigation in progress; rolling restarts and routing changes reduced latency. No data loss.
Next update: 30 minutes or as significant changes occur.
```
Jordan (oncall): +1. Keep the status page concise. Add: customers on Dedicated not impacted, customers with pinned model vqf-1 may have experienced slower responses.
Hannah (CS): Customer note draft (email/SV): empathy + actionable info.
Hannah (CS): CUSTOMER NOTE DRAFT:
```
Hi <CustomerName>,

We experienced a temporary performance degradation impacting some hosted inference requests in the us-west-2 region from ~08:02 UTC to ~08:20 UTC. You may have observed slower responses for requests to model vqf-1. Our team identified a cache eviction pattern under high-memory pressure and applied mitigations (rolling restarts and temporary routing to a variant).

What we did: immediate restarts of affected worker pool, adjusted routing to fallback variant, and reduced batching window to lower memory pressure.
What we know: no customer data was lost or modified. If you logged requests during the window and see errors, please share the request IDs and timestamps and we'll investigate.
What we're doing next: deep RCA, config change to KV cache thresholds, autoscaler tweak, and adding a health check to detect this pattern earlier.

We're sorry for the disruption and we'd like to offer a one-time credit for affected API usage. Please let us know if you'd like to discuss further.

Thanks,
The Redwood Inference Team
```
Amy (Product): add note that Dedicated & Private customers have isolation; clarify whether any customers on Dedicated in us-west-2 were routed to shared pools (shouldn't be).
Kyung (Runtime): confirmed: dedicated pools were not routed to shared pool. Only hosted tenants on vqf-1 variants were impacted.
Matt (ENG): metrics: p95 latency graph updated — drop visible ~08:10 UTC after first restarts. Will attach charts to RCA.
Jordan (oncall): action items (assigning):
- Jordan: assemble timeline + raw logs and put in incident doc (INC-1765432123) — due EOD.
- Kyung: propose KV cache threshold defaults + PR for runtime config — due 48h.
- Matt: automate safe rolling-restart playbook + add pre-checks — due 72h.
- Hannah: queue customer emails for affected orgs with CS approval + credit process — due 24h.
- Amy: classify severity in stakeholder comms and schedule postmortem readout — due 48h.
Lena (SRE): handing off to morning oncall (Amy will lead post-incident) — leaving notes and commands executed in the incident doc.
Jordan (oncall): final note before handoff: latency improved to baseline; still monitoring for regressions. Will update status page to "monitoring" in 20m if stable.
Hannah (CS): small wording tweak: replace "temporary routing" with "temporary fallback model variant" and add a sentence inviting customers to reach out to their CSM.
Amy (Product): acknowledge, will schedule a 1h RCA readout tomorrow and invite CS + Runtime + Eng leads.
Lena (SRE): thanks all — great cross-functional run. Leaving the thread for postmortem additions. :thumbsup:
SRE Bot: Incident INC-1765432123 transitioned to 'Monitoring' by lena at 2024-10-03T08:24:30Z
Jordan (oncall): closing my shift. ping me if regressions crop up, I'm around for the next hour.
Amy (Product): added follow-up checklist to the incident doc and assigned owners.
Matt (ENG): attaching initial heap and eviction logs to INC-1765432123.
Hannah (CS): I'll draft individualized customer emails and run them by legal for the credit language.
Lena (SRE): end of thread summary: short status page posted, customer notification drafts approved by CS, mitigations applied and verified, action items assigned. We'll include timeline + root cause hypothesis in the RCA and share broadly after readout.
